description: The plot illustrates how four sources (Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files) vary in a measured value as the number of tokens changes. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 tokens with labeled ticks at 200-unit intervals (200, 400, 600, 800; the 1000 endpoint is shown by a data point but not labeled as a tick). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with labeled ticks every 10 units (10, 20, 30, 40). The Tutorials series is a blue solid line with circular markers, rising from about 23 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 500, reaching about 29 at 800, then slightly decreasing to about 28 at 1000. The Library Documentation series is a red solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 26 at 200 to about 29 at 500 and about 32 at 800, then dropping to about 27 at 1000. The StackOverflow posts series is a yellow solid line with circular markers, starting near 33 at 200, slightly decreasing to about 31 at 500, then declining to about 19 at 800 and further to about 12 at 1000. The Github files series is a green solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 28 at 200 to about 30 at 500 and about 33 at 800, then decreasing to about 30 at 1000.
